[P2] Recheck expiry after the error-path checkpoint drain

If the handler throws while a child’s terminal checkpoint remains in flight, deadline disposal resolves `waitForQueueCompletion()`. This continuation then calls `createErrorObjectFromError(error)` without rechecking the lifecycle. Custom error accessors therefore execute after disposal and can block the event loop beyond the deadline. The new success-path serialization guard does not cover this error path. Add `lifecycle?.throwIfExpired()` immediately after the error-path drain, before error conversion, and extend the held-checkpoint regression to verify that error accessors do not run after expiry.
